name: Blossom Row
intent: Last of the easy orchard levels and the widest colour spread so far: eight colours and, unlike levels 1-4, almost nothing is shared between boards, so each board has to be worked on its own. The avocado's dark skin, lime flesh and brown pit interleave; the blossom's yellow centre and red petal base are tiny finishing colours whose containers have to be held for a moment. No features.
